svg.title: Let the hurt end here.
svg.desc: A coral line arrives sharp and tangled. At a golden circle containing a pause symbol it stops. A green line emerges in a gentle curve and grows leaves. We cannot choose every feeling. We can choose what we do with it. Pause. Breathe. Choose care. A helping hand. A fair word. A firm boundary. You can be kind and still say no. The next moment is a place to start.
